caption: The drawing features two separate decorative elements. The upper element is a semicircular composition containing a figure of a person with a halo, brown hair and beard, and light skin, clothed in a red and pink robe with brown accents. This person has blue wings and is depicted against a cream background, with their right arm extended outward and left arm bent upward. Flanking the figure on both sides are symmetrical, stylized red, blue, and gold plant motifs growing from gold-colored vases. The edge of the semicircle is bordered with alternating bands of blue, red, and gold colors forming swirling patterns. Beneath the semicircle, a horizontal, rectangular decorative border is shown, primarily composed of a scalloped edge in alternating blue, cream, and red colors with black outlines, matching the border motif seen in the upper semicircle. The entire drawing is done with clear outlines and flat color areas, mostly in shades of red, blue, pink, gold, brown, and cream.
title: Plate 15: The Creation (Lunette): From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
